title.zh: Mistral AI 发布旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）
title.en: Mistral AI Releases Flagship Model Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)

current_state.zh: Mistral 已发布旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4（内部昵称 Le Chonk），采用 MoE 架构，总参数1.05万亿、激活490亿，支持多模态和100万token上下文；API已开放预览，权重计划10月27日公开，Mistral 称其为美欧最强开放权重模型并公布自测基准。
current_state.en: Mistral AI launched Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter model activating 49 billion parameters per query at $1.36/$4.18 per million input/output tokens, which it says will become the strongest open-weight model yet with weights due by end of October.

updates.what_changed_zh: Mistral发布新旗舰模型Large 4，在视觉和网络安全基准测试中表现强劲，其推理设置仅限“none”或“high”。
updates.what_changed_en: Mistral released Large 4, its new flagship model, featuring strong vision and cybersecurity benchmark results and a reasoning setting limited to 'none' or 'high'.
updates.current_state_zh: Mistral发布新旗舰模型Large 4，在视觉和网络安全基准测试中表现强劲，其推理设置仅限“none”或“high”。

updates.title_zh: Mistral Large 4发布：1.05万亿参数，自称做出欧美最强开源模型
updates.title_en: Mistral Large 4发布：1.05万亿参数，自称做出欧美最强开源模型
updates.what_changed_zh: 补充发布细节：Mistral Large 4 为1.05万亿参数MoE模型，每次推理激活490亿参数，原生支持图文输入，上下文最长100万token；API已开放预览，模型权重计划10月27日公开，并给出自测基准成绩。
updates.what_changed_en: Added release details: Mistral Large 4 is a 1.05T-parameter MoE model activating 49B parameters per inference, natively supports image-text input, has up to 1M-token context; API preview is available, open weights are planned for October 27, and self-reported benchmark scores were provided.
updates.current_state_zh: Mistral 已发布旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4（内部昵称 Le Chonk），采用 MoE 架构，总参数1.05万亿、激活490亿，支持多模态和100万token上下文；API已开放预览，权重计划10月27日公开，Mistral 称其为美欧最强开放权重模型并公布自测基准。
updates.current_state_en: Mistral has released flagship model Mistral Large 4 (internally nicknamed Le Chonk), an MoE model with 1.05T total parameters and 49B active parameters, multimodal support and 1M-token context; API preview is available, open weights are planned for October 27, and Mistral claims it is the strongest open-weights model from the US or Europe with self-reported benchmarks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Mistral released its flagship Mistral Large 4, a 1.05T-parameter MoE model activating 49B parameters per inference with multimodal input and 1M-token context, available now via API preview with open weights slated for October 27 and self-reported benchmarks claiming the strongest open-weights model from the US or Europe.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Mistral released its flagship Mistral Large 4, a 1.05T-parameter MoE model activating 49B parameters per inference with multimodal input and 1M-token context, available now via API preview with open weights slated for October 27 and self-reported benchmarks claiming the strongest open-weights model from the US or Europe.
